## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-251-01` — Export Current Evidence asynchronously exports one consistent EvidenceStore view rather than SnapshotExporter output, records manual ownership, reports success or failure in the UI, and reveals the completed bundle in Finder.
- `AC-251-02` — The bundle includes every CONTRACT-250 role with valid hashes and a brief that identifies exact monitored roots, whole-volume versus file-detail scope, coverage gaps, data age, top current directory and file consumers, available growth evidence, cleanup-review leads, and limitations.
- `AC-251-03` — Exact file-level records remain machine-readable and bounded, privacy shaping and secret redaction apply consistently, no file contents or environment values are exported, and absent provenance or growth is stated rather than synthesized.
- `AC-251-04` — A regression drives the actual menu/view-model export path against a populated database and rejects the legacy three-file capacity-only bundle, a false whole-volume detail claim, or a manifest that omits open coverage limitations.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-251-01` (real-export-journey-test) — Seeded and live-database exports verify required files and hashes, decision-useful brief content, top consumers, exact record availability, honest partial coverage, asynchronous UI behavior, Finder reveal, and manual export inventory.
